content:
The 1990 Samara UFO incident is the most baffling. It involves the landing of a Triangular UFO near a Russian radar base, which caused equipment failure at the base. I will try to break down what could have happened. #ufotwitter #uapX

Key information 

UFO encounter on September 13, 1990, at a Soviet long-range radar station near Kuibyshev (now Samara), Russia. According to multiple accounts from UFO literature and declassified reports:

-Around midnight, radar operators detected an unidentified object approaching at low altitude.

-Witnesses described a large, silent black triangular craft (estimated 30-50 feet across) with bright lights or beams.

-The object hovered overhead, then landed nearby.

-It emitted three intense rays or beams toward the radar antenna, causing it to malfunction or partially collapse (described as "destroyed" in some retellings, though details vary on the extent of damage).

-Soldiers at the site prepared to fire on it, but a corporal (named Dudnik in some sources) intervened to prevent escalation.

-The craft remained grounded for two hours without further aggression before departing rapidly.

-No injuries were reported among personnel, though the event allegedly caused alarm and temporary system failures.

-Story originates from Soviet-era military witnesses and has circulated in UFO communities since the early 1990s. It's often cited alongside other "black triangle" sightings, like the Belgian UFO wave of 1989-1990, where similar shapes were reported and even pursued by F-16 jets without interception. 

Strange parts to me are

-UFO strong radar reflection most don't have it
-Rays of lights are most likely secondary effects of propulsion 
-Russian military command didn't take down the craft even if the craft was grounded for two hours which is strangest part in this case

You know my opinion that UFOs are man made vehicles that use Field-Resonance propulsion you know by my research that US and Russia had such crafts long-time ago. 

If people researched UFO propulsion they would knew harmful light apparition is secondary effect. It can easily burn things in close proximity. 

I can't pinpoint if this vehicle was from US or Russian side in example continues over decades US-Russian UFO operations against each other or Russian flight gone wrong. 

Samara UFO incident and Belgium wave events are still inconclusive to me and both events happened in same timeframe 1990.
